verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded documents a broad API covering company onboarding, regular and off-cycle payroll, contractor payments, tax info, and the full time-off lifecycle, plus webhooks, idempotency, versioning, official client libraries and an MCP server. However, nothing states API/UI parity, and some areas route through pre-built UI flows instead, such as Guideline 401(k) access. The CLI also explicitly cannot run or submit payroll. missing for 10: an explicit documented API-parity guarantee with the Gusto UI, API coverage for features currently only reachable via pre-built flows (e.g. Guideline 401(k) and partner benefits), independent hands-on confirmation of coverage breadth.
